name: Audio Effects
description: Set up audio effects for the game.

easy.criteria: Adding ambient background sounds or straightforward sound effects for actions like jumping or picking up items.

medium.criteria: Implementing spatial audio for immersive experiences and adaptive soundtracks that react to gameplay.

hard.criteria: Designing complex audio systems, such as realistic echo/reverb based on environment or detailed audio mixing.

name: Reverse Engineering
description: Analyze an existing code base to derive its functionality.

easy.criteria: Analyze a small, well-documented code base to understand its basic functionality.

medium.criteria: Examine a moderately complex code base, identifying key functions and components.

hard.criteria: Thoroughly analyze a large, poorly documented code base to derive its complete functionality and dependencies.

name: End-to-End Tests
description: Write automated tests that cover the entire user flow.

easy.criteria: Automated testing of critical user flows through the UI, such as signing up or logging in, with a predefined and predictable outcome.

medium.criteria: Automated testing of more complex user flows that may involve conditional logic, multiple user roles, or dynamic content.

hard.criteria: Comprehensive automated testing of several related complex user flows.

name: Multiplayer
description: Implement multiplayer-specific functionality.

easy.criteria: Basic multiplayer interactions like synchronizing basic attributes between client and server/cloud.

medium.criteria: More complex and multiple APIs that drive game state.

hard.criteria: Advanced real-time data exchange and/or streaming.

name: Composing Screens
description: Assemble UI components into full screens.

easy.criteria: Basic screen with up to 3 non-nested components.

medium.criteria: Intermediate screen with up to 6 non-nested components but with possible interactions between them.

hard.criteria: A highly complex screen with nested components, advanced interactions, and real-time updates.

name: Configuring Shaders
description: Configure visual shaders for game graphics.

easy.criteria: Basic shaders for color changes or textures.

medium.criteria: Shaders for complex effects (water, fire).

hard.criteria: Photorealistic rendering, dynamic environmental shaders.

name: Research
description: Brainstorm ideas, perform comparative analysis, and choose an optimal solution.

easy.criteria: Brainstorm ideas and perform basic comparative analysis to choose an optimal solution.

medium.criteria: Conduct detailed comparative analysis, including multiple sources, to select the best solution.

hard.criteria: Perform comprehensive research with in-depth analysis and formal documentation of the chosen solution.

name: Building SuiteScripts
description: Building, maintaining and troubleshooting SuiteScripts.

easy.criteria: Build simple scripts, perform small modifications, or identify and fix basic syntax errors in SuiteScripts.

medium.criteria: Build medium-compexity scripts, perform larger modification or debug complex logic errors using debug statements and variable inspection in the NetSuite debugger.

hard.criteria: Build complex scripts or troubleshoot and resolve performance issues in SuiteScripts. Debug complex interactions between SuiteScripts and other NetSuite components.

name: Clarifying Requirements
description: Clarify requirements with product owners or managers.

easy.criteria: Clarify the given requirements by asking max 2 questions that are answered directly.

medium.criteria: Clarify the given requirements by asking max 5 questions that require a couple of rounds or replies.

hard.criteria: Clarify the given requirements through a longer back-and-fourth discussion or meeting.

name: Building Chatbots
description: Building chatbots that can be integrated into any website.

easy.criteria: Create a simple chatbot with FAQ capabilities or simple logic with max 3 branches, or perform small, incremental updates to an existing chat bot.

medium.criteria: Build a new chatbot with complex logic (more than three branches) and/or KB querying capabilities or add such capabilities to an existing chatbot.

hard.criteria: Build a new chatbot that uses tools, or accessing third-party solutions; or add such capabilities to an existing chatbot.

name: Building tray.io Flows
description: Building tray.io flows to integrate between different software systems.

easy.criteria: Create a simple flow (less than 10 steps) or update less than 5 steps in flows.

medium.criteria: Create a medium complex flow (between 10 and 20 steps) or update between 5 and 20 steps in a flow.

hard.criteria: Create/update a complex flow (change will be more than 20 steps)

name: Creating Mock Data
description: Generate mock data following a given schema or design.

easy.criteria: Create a simple mock for a single model/response with no simulation capabilities (dummy).

medium.criteria: Create a simple mock for chained/linked models/responses with no simulation capabilities (dummy).

hard.criteria: Create mock for a model/rasponse that does simulation (act as an actual API with ability to interpret arguments).

name: Writing AI Prompts
description: Create and fine-tune LLM prompts.

easy.criteria: Create a simple, zero-shot prompt.

medium.criteria: Create a prompt using an "advanced" prompting technique (e.g., CoT, few-shot).

hard.criteria: Create a prompt using a combination of "advanced" prompting techniques (e.g., CoT, few-shot).

name: Metadata Configuration
description: Configuring Salesforce metadata, including custom objects, custom metadata, custom settings, and fields to meet business requirements.

easy.criteria: Create and configure custom fields on standard objects. Set up custom objects and configure basic settings. Implement simple validation rules and field dependencies.

medium.criteria: Configure custom metadata types and custom settings. Implement advanced validation rules and workflow rules. Set up complex field-level security and sharing settings.

hard.criteria: Implement complex custom metadata relationships. Configure and deploy changes using metadata API and tools like Ant Migration Tool. Manage large-scale metadata configurations across multiple environments.

name: Analytics and Dashboard Development
description: Creating and updating analytics, dashboards, and datasets in AWS QuickSight to visualize and analyze data.

easy.criteria: Create basic datasets and analyses in AWS QuickSight. Develop simple dashboards with visualizations. Implement basic filters and parameters in dashboards.

medium.criteria: Develop advanced datasets with joins and calculated fields. Implement interactive dashboards with drill-down capabilities. Use QuickSight Q to build natural language queries.

hard.criteria: Optimize datasets and dashboards for performance and scalability. Implement advanced security and access controls in QuickSight. Develop custom visualizations and extensions using QuickSight SDK.

name: Designing GraphQL APIs
description: Define and implement GraphQL queries, mutations or subscriptions.

easy.criteria: Create or update 1 GraphQL operation accepts and/or returns maximum 10 parameters/fields.

medium.criteria: Create or update max 2 GraphQL operations that accepts and/or return maximum 20 parameters/fields in total.

hard.criteria: Create or update more than 2 GraphQL operations that accepts and/or return more than 20 parameters/fields in total.

name: Designing REST APIs
description: Define and implement RESTful service endpoints.

easy.criteria: Create or update 1 REST operation accepts and/or returns maximum 10 parameters/fields.

medium.criteria: Create or update max 2 REST operations that accepts and/or return maximum 20 parameters/fields in total.

hard.criteria: Create or update more than 2 REST operations that accepts and/or return more than 20 parameters/fields in total.

name: Defining In-Memory DTOs
description: Create or update in-memory core data storage structures.

easy.criteria: Create or update 1-2 related DTOs with less than 10 fields affected in total.

medium.criteria: Create or update up to 4-5 related DTOs with less than 25 fields affected in total.

hard.criteria: Create or update 6+ related DTOs with more than 25 fields affected in total.

name: Building SQL Schemas
description: Design SQL database structures and tables.

easy.criteria: Create or update 1-2 related tables with less than 10 fields affected in total.

medium.criteria: Create or update up to 4-5 related tables with less than 25 fields affected in total.

hard.criteria: Create or update 6+ related tables with more than 25 fields affected in total.

name: Building Reusable Components
description: Create or extend reusable UI components.

easy.criteria: Create or update a component that contains up to 3 child components or elements.

medium.criteria: Create or update a component that contains between 3 and 6 child components or elements.

hard.criteria: Create or update a component that contains more than 6 child components or elements.

name: Flow Management and Automation
description: Creating and managing flows in Salesforce to automate business processes and improve efficiency.

easy.criteria: Create or update simple flows using Flow Builder. Automate basic tasks such as record creation and updates. Implement email alerts and simple approval processes.

medium.criteria: Develop complex flows with multiple screens and decision elements. Implement record-triggered and scheduled flows. Integrate flows with external systems using HTTP callouts.

hard.criteria: Optimize flows for performance and bulk data processing. Develop advanced flows using custom Apex actions. Implement stateful flows for complex, long-running business processes.

name: Develop UI Component
description: Developing user interface components or email templates using Visualforce, Lightning Components, and other Salesforce technologies.

easy.criteria: Create simple Visualforce pages. Develop basic Lightning Components. Implement basic input forms and display data from Salesforce objects.

medium.criteria: Develop Visualforce pages with custom controllers. Implement advanced Lightning Components with Apex controllers. Use SLDS (Salesforce Lightning Design System) to style components.

hard.criteria: Develop highly interactive and dynamic Visualforce pages. Create complex Lightning Web Components (LWC). Integrate third-party libraries and frameworks into Salesforce components.

name: Building Game UI
description: Extend the in-game UI and menus.

easy.criteria: Creating static UI elements like score displays or simple menus.

medium.criteria: Designing and scripting interactive non-native UI elements like two-way switch, custom toggle group, etc.

hard.criteria: Developing complex UI elements/systems with animated transitions, adaptive layouts for different screen sizes, and multi-layered menus.

name: Custom Work
description: Work that does not fit into either competency.

easy.criteria: Easy complexity work, comparable to other easy competency tasks.

medium.criteria: Medium complexity work, comparable to other medium competency tasks.

hard.criteria: Hard complexity work, comparable to other hard competency tasks.

name: Design DynamoDB data model
description: Design DynamoDB database structures

easy.criteria: Extend or update existing entities in an existing table with less than 10 fields affected in total.

medium.criteria: Add a new entity or extend existing entities with at least 10 fields affected.

hard.criteria: Design a whole table with multiple entities or add multiple new entities.

name: Root Cause Analysis
description: Analyze defects to pinpoint root causes, solutions, and mitigating actions.

easy.criteria: Feature impacted by bug is simple, and the cause is obvious.

medium.criteria: Feature impacted by bug is simple xor the cause is not obvious.

hard.criteria: Feature impacted by bug is complex and the cause is not obvious

name: Load Testing
description: Write automated tests to generate load and evaluate system performance.

easy.criteria: Implement a basic load tests based on a single scenario with a simple load profile.

medium.criteria: Implement load tests based on max 3 scenarios with any type of load profile.

hard.criteria: Implement complex load tests based on more than 3 scenarios,

name: Data Transformation
description: Mapping data between data structures (e.g, moving between API data structures in internal data structures).

easy.criteria: Implement basic data mapping between two simple data structures with <10 fields that are directly copied.

medium.criteria: Map data between max 3 related data structures with <20 fields and/or with simple calculations, filters or aggregations.

hard.criteria: Map data between more than 3 related data structures with >=20 fields and/or with complex calculations, filters or aggregations.

name: Error Tracking
description: Detect, track, and cluster errors on the client side.

easy.criteria: Implement basic error tracking for a single component using an existing error tracking tool.

medium.criteria: Implement error tracking for multiple related components using an existing error tracking tool.

hard.criteria: Set up an error tracking tools and implement the most important error tracking scenarios across the entire application.

name: User Tracking
description: Track and analyze user activity.

easy.criteria: Implement basic user activity tracking for a single feature or component using an existing tracking system.

medium.criteria: Track and analyze user activity across multiple components, using an existing tracking system.

hard.criteria: Integrate a new user tracking system and roll it out to the most important product features.

name: Physics
description: Configure, tweak, or use Unity's physics system.

easy.criteria: Implementing basic physics properties to a small amount of game objects like gravity and collisions.

medium.criteria: Creating custom physics interactions, such as objects that can be pushed or pulled in specific ways.

hard.criteria: Developing intricate physics systems, like controlling behaviour of a large amount of physical objects, complex destructible environments, etc...

name: Integrating Backend APIs
description: Call our own backend service APIs from a different component.

easy.criteria: Integrate a simple CRUD operation, mapping to model, and exposing data to a store, service, component, etc.

medium.criteria: Integrate with multiple APIs and join data in a store, service, component, etc.

hard.criteria: Integrate with multiple APIs and perform client-side data processing and joining data in a store, service, component, etc.

name: Styling
description: Apply styling to UI components and screens.

easy.criteria: Involves making minor cosmetic changes to pre-existing components using basic CSS properties such as color, font size, and padding.

medium.criteria: Involves making moderate changes to pre-existing components such as adding new CSS styles, customizing layout and positioning, and adding animations.

hard.criteria: Involves creating custom styles from scratch, implementing complex animations and transitions, and ensuring cross-browser compatibility.

name: State Management
description: Manage application state across components.

easy.criteria: Make incremental changes to an existing state slice and associated reducer, selectors, and actions.

medium.criteria: Implement a new state slice for managing state for components located in the same page.

hard.criteria: Implement a new state slice for managing state for multiple components spread across multiple pages.

name: Attending Meetings
description: Attending meetings

easy.criteria: N/A

medium.criteria: N/A

hard.criteria: N/A

name: Other Untracked Work
description: Other type of work that is not tracked.

easy.criteria: N/A

medium.criteria: N/A

hard.criteria: N/A

name: Reviewing Work
description: Review work done by other engineers.

easy.criteria: N/A

medium.criteria: N/A

hard.criteria: N/A

name: Improve AI Investments
description: Improve our AI investments.

easy.criteria: Perform an isolated update to one of our Playbooks, Second Brains, Context Packs or Quality Bars.

medium.criteria: Perform a small, but overarching/connected update to several of our existing Playbooks, Second Brains, Context Packs or Quality Bars.

hard.criteria: Perform larger updates and/or create a new Playbooks, Second Brains, Context Packs or Quality Bars.

name: Game Testing
description: Perform a range of tests from basic functionality to comprehensive multiplayer stress tests.

easy.criteria: Perform basic play mode tests, simple multiplayer tests, and build verification on a local device.

medium.criteria: Conduct intermediate play mode tests, multiplayer tests on a local server, and build verification on a different device.

hard.criteria: Execute comprehensive play mode tests, advanced multiplayer tests on a dev server, and build verification on multiple devices.

name: Writing Documentation
description: Write product or system documentation.

easy.criteria: Perform small updates on an existing documentation.

medium.criteria: Perform extensive updates on an existing documentation or add a new simple documentation.

hard.criteria: Completely rewrite an existing documentation or add a new extensive documentation.

name: Composing Scenes
description: Compose assets into game scenes.

easy.criteria: Placement or modification of static objects and basic lighting setup.

medium.criteria: Dynamic elements, particle effects, custom lighting.

hard.criteria: Detailed interactive scene modifications e.g optimized environmental effects or large amounts of objects or frequently changed objects.

name: Plan and Design
description: Perform code-level design, generate an implementation plan, and break it into subtasks.

easy.criteria: Plan & design a small <16 SP task.

medium.criteria: Plan & design a medium size >=16 SP, <64 SP task.

hard.criteria: Plan & design a large >=64 SP task.

name: Refactoring Code
description: Refactor existing code to adhere to a new design or use a specific library/pattern.

easy.criteria: Refactor a simple (<= 100 LoC affected) or localized (<= 5 usages affected) component.

medium.criteria: Refactor a medium complexity (<= 250 LoC affected) or somewhat reused (<= 10 usages affected) component.

hard.criteria: Refactor a high complexity (> 250 LoC affected) or highly reused (> 10 usages affected) component.

name: Setting Up New Projects
description: Set up and configure new projects, including repository setup, code structure, configurations, and initial tech stack implementation.

easy.criteria: Set up a basic project with standard repository structure, README, essential configuration files, and initial code structure for a small, single-technology project. Implement basic CI/CD pipeline.

medium.criteria: Set up a project for a medium-sized application with multiple technologies. Include advanced CI/CD configuration, linting rules, comprehensive documentation structure, and initial implementation of core tech stack (e.g., basic CDK setup).

hard.criteria: Set up a complex project for a large-scale application or microservices architecture. Implement advanced CI/CD pipelines, comprehensive documentation, custom development tools or scripts, and full initial tech stack setup (e.g., complex CDK infrastructure).

name: Building AI Agents/Chains
description: Develop agent, chain or graph-based LLM processes.

easy.criteria: Set up a simple conversational agent with no custom tools.

medium.criteria: Set up a chain of maximum 6 steps or a standalone conversational agent with at most 3 tools.

hard.criteria: Set up chain with more than 6 steps or a standalone conversational agent with more than 3 tools.

name: Integration Tests
description: Create integration tests for API endpoints.

easy.criteria: Set up or update an integration test suite consisting of max 3 test cases that can reuse an existing test data set.

medium.criteria: Set up or update an integration test suite consisting of max 5 test cases that require maxium 5 custom test data entries (on top of an existing test data set).

hard.criteria: Set up or update an integration test suite consisting of more than 5 test cases or that require more than 5 custom test data entries (on top of an existing test data set).

name: System Setup and Configuration
description: Setting up and configuring Salesforce environments, including user roles, profiles, security settings, and overall system configuration.

easy.criteria: Set up user roles and profiles. Configure basic security settings and permissions. Customize standard Salesforce applications and tabs.

medium.criteria: Configure advanced security settings, including IP restrictions and two-factor authentication. Set up and manage Salesforce communities. Implement complex sharing rules and manual sharing.

hard.criteria: Configure and manage multiple Salesforce environments (e.g., sandboxes, production). Implement and manage advanced features like Shield Encryption. Develop and execute comprehensive deployment plans.

name: Setting up Data Lake
description: Set up and/or manage a data lake in a cloud.

easy.criteria: Simple Data Lake Setup/Configuration. Set up a basic data lake on a cloud platform with simple storage and retrieval capabilities. This includes defining a basic folder structure, ingesting static files (e.g., CSV, JSON) using manual or basic batch ingestion methods, and setting up basic access controls.

medium.criteria: Data Lake with Automated Ingestion and Data Cataloging. Set up a data lake with automated data ingestion pipelines and implement a data catalog for metadata management. This includes setting up basic ETL processes for data transformation, optimizing storage formats (e.g., Parquet or ORC), and enabling basic query capabilities.

hard.criteria: Data Lake with Real-Time Streaming and/or Data Governance. Create a comprehensive data lake architecture that supports both batch and real-time data ingestion. This involves implementing advanced data governance, security (e.g., fine-grained access controls), data quality checks, and compliance mechanisms.

name: Building Editor Tools
description: Build custom Unity Editor tools.

easy.criteria: Simple editor scripts for task automation.

medium.criteria: Custom tools for asset processing, level design tools.

hard.criteria: Tool behaviour is complex and the API for the logic and/or controls isn't built-in.

name: Implementing Business Logic
description: Write business logic code.

easy.criteria: Simple processing of business logic, i.e. the number of rules and actions is under 3

medium.criteria: Moderately complex business logic, i.e. the number of rules and actions is under 5

hard.criteria: Advanced business logic, i.e. the number of rules and actions is over 5.

name: Writing SQL Queries
description: Create and optimize SQL database queries, leveraging ORMs or similar libraries if needed.

easy.criteria: Simple query on one table or simple joins with 2-3 tables.

medium.criteria: Query with up to 5 joins and/or 5 computed/aggregated columns.

hard.criteria: Query with more than 5 joins or more than 5 computed/aggregated columns.

name: Game Mechanics
description: Develop and implement game mechanics.

easy.criteria: Simple scripts for basic mechanics.

medium.criteria: More complex gameplay scripts (single player mini games, inventory, input, basic AI, etc..).

hard.criteria: Advanced systems (procedural generation, complex AI, multiplayer, abilities, etc...).

name: Manual Testing
description: Manually test the application to ensure correctness.

easy.criteria: Test involving few steps and for which no data needs to be created (including for the story demo)

medium.criteria: Test involving a reasonable amount of steps (max 10 steps) or some data (max 5 rows) needs to be created (including for the story demo)

hard.criteria: Test involving a large amount of steps (>10) or a complex data constellation (>5 rows) that needs to be created (including for the story demo)

name: Integrating third-party Assets
description: Reuse and integrate third-party assets within the game.

easy.criteria: The asset is well written, and the integration doesn't require overriding existing similar functionality/library/asset.

medium.criteria: The asset is lacking the ability to integrate seamlessly with our project and requires a bit of modifications to follow the project patterns while integrating.

hard.criteria: The asset requires replacement or quite a bit of modifications to existing project code/library/asset to integrate it.

name: CI/CD
description: Set up continuous integration and delivery pipelines.

easy.criteria: Update an existing CI/CD pipeline, by changing or adding at most 3 steps.

medium.criteria: Create or update a CI/CD pipeline by adding/updating at most 6 steps.

hard.criteria: Create or update a CI/CD pipeline by adding/updating more than 6 steps.

name: Building or Extending Assets
description: Build custom assets or extend existing ones.

easy.criteria: Update doesn't introduce breaking changes, neither does it override any modifications we had to do to the asset during integration.

medium.criteria:
Update introduces breaking changes that changed the behaviour of the asset for better or worse, and requires updating the integration parameters.

But the update didn't override modifications we made to the asset.

hard.criteria: Update introduces breaking changes and overrides changes we made to integrate the asset; this is effectively a re-integration with modifications.

name: Infrastructure as Code
description: Create or update infrastructure as code using AWS CDK.

easy.criteria: Update IaC for a resource that's already in the stack (e.g. existing Lambda)

medium.criteria: Add IaC for a set of maximum 3 related resources of an already used type (e.g., new Lambdas in a stack that already has Lambdas).

hard.criteria: Add IaC for a set of more than 3 resources or of a new type that was not used before (eg. AWS Ground Station)

name: Integrating AWS Services
description: Connect and use AWS managed services, leveraging the SDK.

easy.criteria: Use an already integrated AWS service in a new use case (e.g., S3 upload for a backend that already uploads to S3).

medium.criteria: Integrate a new simple AWS service that wasn't used before in the product (e.g., S3 upload for a backend that doesn't yet use S3).

hard.criteria: Integrate a new complex AWS Service that wasn't used before in the product (e.g., a service that requires polling its job status like AWS Bedrock).

name: Integrating 3rd party APIs
description: Connect and use 3rd party APIs.

easy.criteria: Use an already integrated third-party API in a new use case.

medium.criteria: Integrate a new simple third party API that wasn't used before in the product (e.g., a service that exposes a simple REST API).

hard.criteria: Integrate a new complex API that wasn't used before in the product (e.g., a service that requires multiple interlocked steps to perform an operation).

name: Develop SOQL Query
description: Writing SOQL to retrieve data from Salesforce databases.

easy.criteria: Write basic SOQL queries to retrieve data from a single object. Use simple filters in SOQL queries. Retrieve specific fields from an object.

medium.criteria: Write SOQL queries to retrieve data from multiple related objects. Use aggregate functions (COUNT, SUM, AVG) in SOQL queries. Write SOQL queries with subqueries.

hard.criteria: Optimize complex SOQL queries for performance. Write advanced SOQL queries using polymorphic relationships. Implement dynamic SOQL queries in Apex.

name: Logging and Monitoring
description: Write logs for troubleshooting and add metrics to monitor and analyze system performance.

easy.criteria: Write simple logs to document user actions, errors, results, etc.

medium.criteria: Publish custom metrics and/or pattern based logs to trigger alarms in specific circumstances.

hard.criteria: Set up logging and monitoring from scratch for a product/module.

name: Unit Tests
description: Write unit tests for individual code units.

easy.criteria: Writing tests for simple, isolated functions or components with clear input-output behavior, with max 2 internal branches and max 5 mocks.

medium.criteria: Writing tests for more complex functions or components that may involve several mocks (max 10) and several branches (max 5).

hard.criteria: Writing comprehensive tests functions with complex logic involve more than 10 mocks and/or more than 5 branches.
